name: Cooking Companions
source:
Deep in the woods of the Tatras Mountains, you find yourself trapped with a group of four savory adults. As supplies dwindle and flood waters rise, it’s up to you to keep spirits high and make the most of your survival skills. Will you butter up the right person? Or will you wind up on the chopping block?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263230/]Steam[/url]]
